description: Numeric Monte Carlo estimate for discounted path values.

ci_95.description: 95% confidence interval for the discounted mean.

max.description: Optional maximum of captured discounted path values.

mean.description: Mean of the discounted path values.

median.description: Optional median of captured discounted path values.

min.description: Optional minimum of captured discounted path values.

num_paths.description:
Number of independent path estimators contributing to the estimate.

With variance reduction disabled (`antithetic = false`), this equals the
number of simulated sample paths. With antithetic variates enabled each
estimator is the mean of an antithetic pair, so
`num_simulated_paths == 2 * num_paths`. The engine records both so
downstream consumers can distinguish statistical sample size from
simulation work.

num_simulated_paths.description:
Total number of simulated sample paths driving the estimator.

Equal to `num_paths` without variance reduction. When
[`crate::monte_carlo::engine::McEngineConfig::antithetic`] is enabled this is twice
`num_paths` because each estimator averages an antithetic pair of
paths.

percentile_25.description: Optional 25th percentile of captured discounted path values.

percentile_75.description: Optional 75th percentile of captured discounted path values.

std_dev.description: Optional sample standard deviation of discounted path values.

stderr.description: Standard error of the discounted mean.

title: Estimate
